div.head: IV Atr 5.4
div.ab: Et monetarii, qui in nemoribus operantur uel alicubi similibus fabricant, uitę suę culpabiles sint, nisi rex uelit eorum misereri.
Et monetarii, qui in nemoribus operantur vel alicubi similibus fabricant, vitae suae culpabiles sint, nisi rex velit eorum misereri.
And moneyers who carry on their business in woods or work in other such places shall forfeit their lives, unless the king is willing to pardon them.
Und Münzer, welche in Wäldern arbeiten oder sonstwo in ähnlichen [heimlichen Orten] schmieden, seien [des Verlustes] ihres Lebens schuldig, ausser wenn der König sich ihrer erbarmen will.
And moneyers who work in woods or forge anywhere in similar [secret places], let them be liable [to lose] their lives, unless the king is willing to have mercy on them.
